hints.title: Inspect Right Boundary
hints.text: Look at the rightmost character of the string.

hints.title: Strip Zero Characters
hints.text: Continuously strip consecutive zeros from the right end until a non-zero digit is encountered.

hints.title: String Trim Code

complexity.notes: Single linear pass from the end.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting to integer can overflow fixed bit integer sizes on long numerical strings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct slice uses no auxiliary heap memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves via string trimming rather than arithmetic parsing.
